card.name: Hours and times in dosing frequency
card.fires_on: The time unit word (hours, times, day, hourly) that ends a dosing-frequency phrase such as "every 3 or 4 hours". It is strongest in eye ointment and drop instructions.

modes.label: Hours after every-N
modes.description: The word hours after "every" and a number or range in eye-product directions.
modes.example: Apply the ointment in the affected eye every 3 or 4<< hours>>, depending on the severity of the condition

modes.label: Other frequency words
modes.description: Times, hourly or day in phrases about how often or how long something happens.
modes.example: The burned areas should be covered with SULFAMYLON Cream at all<< times>>.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning daily, around the clock or continuous.
card.plain: It marks the unit in "every few hours" style directions, where the text is about to say how often.
